_comment: MCP Server Configuration — Copy to mcp.json and add your API keys

args: const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); const { homedir, platform } = require('node:os'); const { join } = require('node:path'); const bin = process.env.ENGRAM_BIN || (platform() === 'win32' ? join(homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'bin', 'engram.exe') : join(homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'bin', 'engram')); const child = spawn(bin, ['mcp', '--tools=agent'], { stdio: 'inherit', windowsHide: true }); child.on('error', () => process.exit(127)); child.on('exit', (code, signal) => { if (typeof code === 'number') process.exit(code); process.kill(process.pid, signal || 'SIGTERM'); });
